openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything besides the wait and the ride (e.g. Trail, Alert exposure to watchers at stops, limits on who may ride)?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 says time only, no fare; anything more is undecided and not in this timetable.

openQuestions.question: Is an interchange transfer on foot (e.g. T1/circus to S1/circus, about 119 m) priced as walk time, and does the second line's wait count?
openQuestions.why: Cross-line journey sec here excludes the walk and the second wait.

notes: Speeds are starting values [S], tune by playtest: tram 7 m/s (about 25 km/h), sky rail 10 m/s (36 km/h). Run sec = chainage gap / speed, rounded to whole seconds for trams.
Dwell [S]: tram 20 s, sky rail 15 s. Headway [S]: T1 and T2 150 s, S1 120 s.
Journey sec = in-vehicle time: runs plus dwell at each intermediate stop. Price of a trip = wait + sec; wait is 0 to headway (average half).
Cross-line journey sec sums the ride on each line and excludes the wait for the second line and the walk between platforms. Interchange dwell is not counted.
Both directions use the same run times on the double track. The T1 and S1 loop paths carry no stops, so they are turnaround only and have no timed run.

The last journey is listed as T2/harbour to T1/circus via the Harbour interchange then S1 to Crown Circus. Its sec covers the S1 ride only (22 s), and the final T1 boarding is the same Crown Circus interchange.
T1 and T2 run through off-sheet termini, so only on-sheet stops are timed. T1/comet is the first stop and T2/lantern and T2/harbour are the first and last on-sheet stops.
Plan questions on the circus terminus and on retiring the Sphere loop are Datum's. If the lines change, these times must be recomputed.
